data.title: Unit 9: Heat, light and sound
Heat and light
data.heading: Electricity and magnetism
data.text: Electricity is a form of energy produced due to the flow of electrons.
Electricity can be produced from wind, water, sunlight, and by burning fuels like petroleum, coal, and gas.
Magnetism is the attraction between two objects. An object that has the ability to attract is said to be magnetic.
The process of making an object magnetic by passing electric current through it is called electromagnetism.
